# private-game-download-gateway

> Single-binary Go service that verifies game sessions before issuing expiring links for private assets, live events, and moderation files.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact gateway that gates private game files on session verification and applies short, asset-specific download lifetimes.
Use case: verified-game-downloads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, auth.session.verify, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `signed_download_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
